Description of the Place Where I Live

I live in the countryside, and my neighborhood is very quiet and beautiful.
There are many trees and animals, and there are small houses.
There is a store next to my house, and other houses are about fifteen or twenty minutes away.
The air is fresh and clean. I like my neighborhood because it is peaceful.
People live in peace and harmony.
